method: Serial actual streamProxy synthetic Response; counts separate from HeapProfiler sampling (4096 bytes, 2 warmups, 6 iterations), wire fixture prebuilt before sampling; WeakRef after 8 GC turns with stream/results/signals retained. No real network or credentials.

downstream.coverage: Separate existing downstream regression fixtures, not a single proxy-to-physical-terminal end-to-end run.

limits: Heap sampling totals are cumulative allocated bytes, not peak resident memory; settlement heap is only sampled at stream completion.
JSON wire decoding and native reader/EventStream delivery still allocate; stream Promise counts include those costs and one extra final cleanup Promise.
SSE buffering remains proportional to one unfinished protocol line; per-call parser raw/root/token/stack capacity follows input and is disposed.
Existing text/thinking event wrappers and rendered text/layout allocations remain. No object pools or CPU speed claim.
